# Acrolls

> Acrolls is an open-source SvelteKit publishing and documentation framework. It turns Markdown and mdsvex into publication-grade articles and a nested documentation shell while the host keeps ownership of routing, content storage, auth, and deployment.

Use this file as the shortest reliable path through the Acrolls documentation. Read the
integration guide before changing a host. For a local clone, build Acrolls first and refresh
the host's `file:` dependencies after package changes. Prefer the Markdown-safe preprocessor
over calling `mdsvex(...)` directly. `.md` is prose; `.svx` may contain intentional Svelte.

## Start here

- [Documentation handbook](docs/README.md): Orientation, package boundaries, and the self-serve host path.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): Build Acrolls and render the first article in an existing SvelteKit app.
- [Integration checklist](docs/checklist.md): Verification gates for a host trial.
- [Guided onboarding](docs/cli.md#onboard): Run `acrolls onboard` for exact file-by-file snippets, cautions, checkpoints, and deployment verification; use `--json` for a UI/modal client.
- [Product definition](PRODUCT.md): What Acrolls owns and what remains the host's responsibility.
- [Technical architecture](TECH.md): Runtime, package, and workspace assumptions.

## Install and integrate

- [Local installation](docs/local-install.md): Link built Acrolls packages into a host before npm publication.
- [SvelteKit integration](docs/integrate-sveltekit.md): Configure the mdsvex preprocessor, extensions, styles, articles, and generated docs.
- [SvelteKit config snippet](docs/snippets/svelte.config.js): Minimal host wiring using `createAcrollsMdsvexPreprocessor`.
- [Docs shell](docs/docs-shell.md): Configure nested navigation, TOC, breadcrumbs, pager, and persistence.
- [Docs source snippets](docs/snippets/docs-source.ts): Build a generated docs tree from Markdown globs.
- [Document route snippets](docs/snippets/document-page.svelte): Render lazy docs entries through the shell.

## Author content

- [Content authoring](docs/content-authoring.md): Frontmatter, Markdown, mdsvex, code fences, Mermaid, images, and components.
- [Styles](docs/styles.md): Choose foundation or default CSS and bridge host tokens.
- [Article layout snippets](docs/snippets/article-page.svelte): Wrap article content with `Publication`.
- [Generated docs layout](docs/snippets/docs-generated-layout.svelte): Compose the docs shell around route content.

## Packages and APIs

- [Packages reference](docs/packages.md): Responsibilities and public entrypoints for every Acrolls package.
- [`@acrolls/mdsvex` README](packages/mdsvex/README.md): GFM, slugs, Shiki, Mermaid recovery, source safety, and HTML rendering.
- [`@acrolls/svelte` README](packages/svelte/README.md): Publication components, article enhancers, and Mermaid behavior.
- [`@acrolls/docs` README](packages/docs/README.md): Docs shell APIs and content helpers.
- [CLI reference](docs/cli.md): `onboard`, `validate`, `studio`, `integrate`, and local package rebuild commands.

## Safety and verification

- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): Stale local packages, Svelte compile failures, source-safety warnings, tables, TOC, and Studio boundaries.
- [Source-safety implementation](packages/mdsvex/src/source-safety.ts): Narrow Markdown normalization before mdsvex parses prose.
- [Source-safety tests](packages/mdsvex/src/source-safety.test.ts): Regression coverage for literals, fences, Mermaid, `.svx`, and source locations.
- [Mermaid guard](packages/mdsvex/src/remark-mermaid-guard.ts): Recovery for unfenced Mermaid declarations in generated Markdown.
- [Validation checklist](docs/checklist.md): Confirm package builds, host wiring, content rendering, and production build.

## Deployment

- [Getting started — deployment notes](docs/getting-started.md): Follow the host's SvelteKit adapter and deployment process after local validation.
- [Troubleshooting — stale file packages](docs/troubleshooting.md): Rebuild Acrolls, reinstall the host link, and restart the dev server.
- [CLI validation](docs/cli.md): Run `acrolls validate ./path/to/page.md` during development and `--strict` in CI when explicit literal-code authoring is required.
- [Agent deployment handoff](docs/cli.md#agent-handoff): From the host root, render `acrolls onboard --non-interactive --docs-dir docs --base-href /docs --json`, follow each checkpoint, then let the host own its adapter, credentials, and deployment command.
